ana: kicking off 5% canary for release/2026-06-02. change window 10:00-14:00 PT. i'll watch slo dashboards for 15m. release notes: https://internal.redwood/release/2026-06-02 :eyes:

deploy-bot: Canary started - job=canary-2026-06-02-5pct target=embeddings routing=5% :rocket:

kevin: seeing p95 climb on embeddings.route to ~480ms at 1761234570, baseline ~240ms. error rate up 0.05% -> 0.4% in last 2m. dashboard: https://obs.redwood/d/embeds

sre-oncall: alert firing: slo_alert(embeds/p95>400ms,5m). Can you paste alert filter?

kevin: Query: sum(rate(http_responses_total{route="/v1/embeddings",code!~"2..",deploy_tag="canary"}[5m])) / sum(rate(http_requests_total{route="/v1/embeddings",deploy_tag="canary"}[5m])) > 0.003

ana: traces show occasional upstream 502s and grpc: "connection reset" around 1761234568. deploy diff?

deploy-bot: Config diff: increased soft_batch_ms from 5 -> 12 for canary, and enabled kv-prefill=true. Diff link: https://ci.redwood/config-diffs/2026-06-02/canary

sre-oncall: big soft-batch bump likely causing larger requests -> upstream overload. Plan: pause canary, revert soft_batch_ms to 5ms for canary pool, run a 1% synthetic probe. If probe stable, resume 2% and observe 10m.

ana: agreed, prefer patch over full rollback. /deploy pause canary job=canary-2026-06-02-5pct (requested by ana)

deploy-bot: Canary paused. routing 0%. traces sampling increased.

kevin: applying config: soft_batch_ms=5 and kv-prefill=false for canary, starting synthetic-probe at 5rps for 90s.

deploy-bot: config-change applied (id=1761234582). synthetic job synthetic-verify-1761234585 started. logs: https://ci.redwood/logs/canary-2026-06-02/1761234585

sre-oncall: synthetic looks clean: p95 ~250ms, errors ~0.01%, no 502s. resume to 2% now. /deploy resume canary job=canary-2026-06-02-5pct target=2% (requested by ana)

deploy-bot: Canary ramped to 2%. alert window=5m, high sampling.

ana: marking ticket REL-2026-06-02 as PAUSED->PATCHED->RESUMED(2%). will add postmortem item: preflight check for soft_batch_ms increases and kv-prefill interaction tests. thanks team :thumbsup:
